children.name: Gemmatimonas aurantiaca
children.description: Gemmatimonas aurantiaca is a Gram-negative, aerobic, polyphosphate-accumulating micro-organism.

children.name: Gemmatimonas groenlandica
children.description: Gemmatimonas groenlandica is a bacterium species from the genus of Gemmatimonas which has been isolated from a stream in Zackenberg Valley, Greenland.
